name: se-receiver-dp-thresholds
description: Single-ended D+ receiver: switching threshold and output levels at the ratified VIL/VIH input voltages (spec/usb2-device-phy.md §4, §8.2).
claim: spec/usb2-device-phy.md#4-receiver-set -- single-ended receiver on D+, VIH > 2.0 V and VIL < 0.8 V; and spec/usb2-device-phy.md#82-what-gets-measured-and-against-which-section row 'Receiver thresholds' (D+ single-ended half).
derive: meas dc rxd_at_vil FIND v(rxdp) AT=0.8
meas dc rxd_at_vih FIND v(rxdp) AT=2.0

vth_v.description: spec §4: the D+ single-ended switching threshold must sit strictly inside the VIL/VIH window, otherwise either a 0.8 V input is not guaranteed low or a 2.0 V input is not guaranteed high

out_at_vil.description: spec §4: with the input at VIL = 0.8 V the output must be a valid logic low (≤ 0.1 × VDD)

out_at_vih.description: spec §4: with the input at VIH = 2.0 V the output must be a valid logic high (≥ 0.9 × VDD)
